title: A6/A7 independent paper: proof-dependency audit and explicit composite/stability draft
question: Can the fixed A6/A7 Gaussian current and covariance-normal random-coefficient energy be presented as a standalone specialist paper with complete dependencies, explicit stability boundaries and reproducible falsification checks?
method: Inspect the pinned production reference, A6/A7 proof notes, manifests, legacy scripts and R-194/R-195 endpoint scopes.
Perform separate read-only internal audits of current reconstruction, energy/stability and primary-source applicability.
Write explicit paracontrolled commutator/localization and strong Bessel-weighted covariance convergence instead of inheriting compressed proof steps.
Derive sharp lower/upper Pauli contraction slopes and a deterministic bounded-background determinant estimate from the fixed formulas.
Compare 49 nonconstant scalar Gaussian-IBP cases with independent exact Wick recursion; test each of the three connection families by hostile mutations.
Replay the original A6/A7 ingredient programs into new output destinations and verify issued reports unchanged.
finding: A complete content-review draft and dependency audit now cover the canonical current, the full rational random-coefficient centered energy, leading local compensation slopes, subcritical escape, critical noncoercivity and a deterministic-background exponential bound. New finite checks pass 80/80 and reject 13 mutations; fresh legacy A6 and A7 ingredient aggregates pass 64/64 and 74/74. The earlier general cutoff-rate, prescribed-dyadic, direct Stratonovich and production-anomaly readings are not inherited. The draft also corrects bibliography metadata and states the source manifest/status discrepancy explicitly.
decision_reason: The combined model construction and explicit stability boundaries form a coherent specialist-paper candidate. Established Gaussian, paracontrolled and determinant mechanisms are credited; no general methodological novelty or priority is certified. The analytic target retains its random coefficient rather than being replaced by the easier deterministic background.
boundary: This is an internal content and finite-verification checkpoint, not external mathematical or specialist novelty review. Final PDF render review, sealed archive extraction, canonical integration and verified remote push remain required. Existing claim tiers, interacting-Gibbs and A13 gates are unchanged; no physical vacuum, floor removal, thermodynamic limit or journal submission is asserted.
next_action: Finish the revised-source reread, compile and render every PDF page, seal a portable handoff package and test its extracted verification. Then run repository release/fresh-PDF gates, commit and submit a fixed checkpoint to the integration owner for ordinary push and live remote-head verification. Seek actual independent review without relabelling internal AI audits as external reports.
